summary: Backend-only test pass for the new LiveKit integration (/api/livekit/*). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_livekit.py with 15 tests covering DJ/viewer token minting, JWT claim structure, viewer 409 guardrail, stream start/stop lifecycle, status + active-streams endpoints, slug sanitization, backwards-compat WebSocket relay endpoints, and input validation. Also verified DJ profile sync directly via MongoDB. All 14 executed tests passed (1 skipped by design because the synthetic TEST_ dj_id doesn't exist in dj_profiles — sync was independently verified with a real DJ record).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/livekit.py: /livekit/stream/start and /livekit/stream/stop accept raw `dict` bodies — should use Pydantic models for consistent 422 validation and OpenAPI docs.

routes/livekit.py stream/start does NOT sanitize location_slug the same way as /livekit/token (only .strip().lower(), no regex). A caller could create a livekit_streams doc with slug 'Edgewood Atlanta!' (lowercased to 'edgewood atlanta!') that would never match the sanitized room name used by /livekit/token, breaking viewer joins. Recommend applying the same re.sub sanitization in start/stop/status for consistency.
No auth/authorization on stream/start or stream/stop — any client with a dj_id can mark any location live or kill any live stream. Consider requiring admin/DJ auth.
TTL of 2h on tokens is fine; consider making it configurable via env.
No index on livekit_streams.location_slug — add unique index for correctness and performance.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md does not exist — flagged. LiveKit creds are already in backend/.env and worked.
seed_data_creation: Tests use TEST_ prefixed dj_id and clean up livekit_streams via /livekit/stream/stop in a module-scoped autouse fixture. Direct DB sync check used real DJ id but reverted live_stream_url to None after stop.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LiveKit endpoints under /api/livekit/* are all working: token (dj+viewer), stream/start, stream/stop, stream/status/{slug}, streams/active. JWT claims include correct video grants (roomJoin=true, canPublish=true for dj / canPublish false for viewer). Slug sanitization applies inside /livekit/token but NOT inside stream/start (see code review). Backwards-compat /api/stream/active and /api/stream/active/{slug} GET endpoints still return 200. Frontend LiveKit UI (DJPanelPage LiveKitBroadcaster + SocialWallPage LiveKitViewer) not exercised — main agent may self-verify.
